note: Seed candidates only — from dossier.json plus a handful of names distilled straight out of the league's own chat, where 'ring of honor' has been a running idea since 2022. The raw chat itself never enters this repo. Nothing here is inducted. See docs/ROADMAP.md and the Ring of Honor page for how induction actually works.

people.name: Keith
people.blurb: One of the league's all-time best owners — a four-time SCFL champion whose Machines are a perennial blue-blood contender
people.argument: Four rings, the loudest voice in the chat by 54,000+ messages, and he once drove to a public library to pull 1997 microfilm just to win an argument. If this league has a main character, it’s him.

people.name: Horse Collars
people.blurb: Dry, dark, deadpan humor — the guy who drops a war-trenches bit mid-waiver-talk
people.argument: Runs a garden, trades stocks, coaches two youth teams, and still shows up to argue that one Geno Smith game personally cost him 11 wins. Committed to the bit in every direction at once.

people.name: Dan / Scamps / PCE
people.blurb: The chat's center of gravity — everyone references 'Dan'
people.argument: The center of gravity for the entire chat — the one manager people refer to by first name alone. Keeps a running blood feud with Creams alive for the fun of it, and treats trade honor like scripture.

people.name: Smoke Dragons
people.argument: Kept the group chat alive through the political wars, then built an entire newsroom out of it afterward. He’s the one who said "if we distilled our stories into 5 people we could write an incredible movie" — and he wasn’t wrong.

people.name: Creams, a.k.a. 'Dwayne'
people.team: Still The Creamiest / Still The Cream
people.blurb: Wheels and deals — 'I always make moves via trade or waivers'; the league's most active trader/waiver hawk
people.argument: The league’s most active trader, defends players he’s already cut, and has never once backed down from the 1,600-yard high school stat the chat spent a decade trying to debunk. Legendary, unverifiable, permanent.

people.name: Powers of Pain (PoP)
people.blurb: The reigning champ who openly stares at his four rings 🏆🏆🏆🏆 to soothe himself
people.argument: Reigning champion, four rings, and the self-appointed anti-kicker crusader with an actual proposed "🚫 K bill." Runs the league’s rules fights for sport and still finds time to win.

people.name: New World Order (NWO)
people.blurb: The unofficial commissioner-organizer — starts side chats about rules, runs the Zoom, posts 'official trade', locks the draft date
people.argument: The unofficial commissioner nobody voted for and everybody needed — runs the Zoom, locks the draft date, posts "official trade" before anyone has to ask. The league’s actual institutional memory.

people.name: Killer Klowns
people.status: left the league (last active Feb 2026) — but a CHAMPION (2024)
people.blurb: Chill stoner-philosopher energy — blunts, weather events, market-crash and Musk conspiracies
people.argument: Took over a dead franchise and turned it into a 2024 title on "believe in the process" alone. Left the league quietly, and is remembered fondly anyway — "appreciate it fellas 🍻."

people.name: Sheq; earlier chat name '~Dave Sheq'
people.blurb: Elite laugher (haha x545) and the deep prospect nerd — rattles off draft boards from memory ('ARICH BIJAN STROUD YOUNG MOODY GIBBS...')
people.argument: The deepest prospect nerd in the chat, can recite a full draft board from memory, and laughs so hard and so often it’s basically a personality trait (haha x545).

people.name: Coach Nick / Wookie; earlier '~Wookie'
people.team: Wookie Leaks (was 'The Dry Dicks' for a stretch)
people.blurb: The chat's lol-machine (1,200+) — goofy, self-deprecating, gleefully headed to hell for his own jokes
people.argument: 1,200+ jokes deep and still going — the chat’s actual lol-machine, self-deprecating to the bone. The whole group quietly pulled for him through a real 2026 health scare. That’s not nothing.

people.name: Lil Chops (has run Lamb Chops / The Porkys / A-Team)
people.team: Lil Chops (has run Lamb Chops / The Porkys / A-Team)
people.blurb: The perpetual rebuilder — 'It's rebuilding, I have two QBs on IR' — and proud of it
people.argument: Proudly, permanently rebuilding — "I have two QBs on IR" — while simultaneously trying to reform the entire league’s format rules. Committed to losing with integrity.

people.name: Tommy / Tom Vertucci
people.blurb: The chat's rambling philosopher — human-nature musings, 'Life After People' docs, history audiobooks
people.argument: The chat’s philosopher-in-residence, dropping dynasty wisdom and Life After People trivia in the same breath, self-aware enough to admit mid-argument when he’s "losing me lol."

people.name: Jim Hunt
people.status: active — THREE-PEAT CHAMPION (2021-2023), the league's dynasty
people.blurb: The blue-collar tough-guy king — union-electrician world, Greenpoint nights, keeps the trophy/belt tradition sacred ('take a shot out of the Trophy together')
people.argument: Three-peat champion, 2021–2023, the league’s actual dynasty — and still the guy hosting golf outings and defending the trophy-shot tradition. Blue-collar royalty.

people.name: Mike; earlier '~Mike'
people.status: LEFT the league/chat (last active June 2022) — a former champion (2019)
people.blurb: The trade-news wire — constantly posted breaking NFL rumor tweets (Matt Ryan, Watson, Bridgewater)
people.argument: A 2019 champion who left the chat in 2022 but is still remembered for running the league’s NFL-rumor trade wire solo, and for nearly rebranding to "Ned’s Nuggets" on his way out.

people.name: Cousin Pete; chat name '~Pete'
people.blurb: The chat's hype-man and exclamation-point machine (!!!!) — congratulates everyone, refers to himself in the third person as 'Guido's'
people.argument: Came home from a 2026 hospital stay to a chat full of well-wishes and immediately reassured everyone he still wasn’t trading Ja’Marr Chase. The league’s hype-man, unconditionally.

people.name: Jay; chat name '~Jay'
people.blurb: The social glue — hosts the crew for cookouts, Tee Bar afternoons and golf ('my house, 2pm-???')
people.argument: Hosts the cookouts, the golf, the Tee Bar afternoons — the actual social glue holding sixteen owners together outside the app. Also the guy who begged for "NO POLITICS NO RELIGION" and mostly got it.

athletes.name: Derrick Lewis
athletes.blurb: "The Black Beast" — UFC heavyweight, the division’s all-time knockout record, and the most quotable post-fight mic in the sport. A league favorite for being exactly as unbothered as he looks.
athletes.argument: Named "first ballot" by more than one manager, independently, in the same conversation — not a bit one guy kept alive alone.

athletes.name: Jameis Winston
athletes.blurb: The chat has been calling him a first-ballot SCFL Hall of Famer since at least 2025 — a running, multi-manager consensus pick, not a one-person bit.
athletes.argument: Called a first-ballot SCFL Hall of Famer and, in the same breath, someone’s outright favorite person in sports. A running position, not a single fan’s bit.

athletes.name: Bob Uecker
athletes.blurb: The voice of the Brewers for over 50 years and the deadpan star of the Major League movies — nominated outright in the chat as an SCFL Ring of Honor member.
athletes.argument: Nominated by name, unprompted, the same day the chat learned who he was: "an American treasure." Fifty years on Brewers radio plus Major League — case closed.

athletes.name: Willie Mack
athletes.blurb: Pro wrestler, and a genuine league connection — one manager’s wife makes his ring gear. The chat calls him a legend, and means it literally, not as a bit.
athletes.argument: A real, personal tie, not a fandom-from-a-distance pick — one manager’s wife makes his ring gear — and the chat calls him a legend without a hint of irony.

athletes.name: Eli Manning
athletes.blurb: A years-long running argument for first-ballot honors, championed loudest by the league’s Giants fans but debated by more than one manager, more than once.
athletes.argument: A years-long, multi-manager argument for first-ballot honors — loudest from the league’s Giants fans, but never once contested by anyone else either.
